from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    separator = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)\n    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)}\n    upper, lower = grid[:separator], grid[separator + 1:]\n    changes = {c: abs(sum(x == c for row in upper for x in row) - sum(x == c for row in lower for x in row)) for c in colors}\n    winner = max(sorted(changes), key=lambda c: changes[c])\n    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]\n'''
path=programs/'task-fe008f21.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'), globals())
